name: Schezwan Fried Rice
steps: Use rice that was cooled promptly after cooking and refrigerated. Break up clumps gently before stir-frying.
Cut carrot, cabbage and capsicum into small pieces. Slice spring onion, keeping green tops separate, and mince garlic and ginger.
Heat a wide wok, add oil, garlic, ginger and spring onion whites and stir for 30 seconds.
Add carrot, cabbage and capsicum and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add rice, schezwan sauce, soy sauce and vinegar. Toss over high heat for 4–5 minutes until the rice is steaming hot throughout, working in batches if needed.
Taste before adding salt, finish with spring onion greens and serve immediately. Check the sauce label for vegetarian ingredients.
tips: Rinse grains before cooking, use a heavy pan and rest covered before fluffing or serving.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
